finding.summary: HKMA issued a Practice Guide on Data Excellence to all Authorized Institutions. It expects AIs to take its industry good practices into account when strengthening risk-data management across governance and accountability, data-quality management and control, and data infrastructure; the Guide creates no separate prescriptive requirement or mandated model.
finding.title: Practice Guide on Data Excellence
